title: Infographic | Amplifier Smart Tools
name: Infographic
description: Turn an idea into a styled infographic, or direct a freeform image of your own. Review the actual result, refine it, and keep the original.
alt: Actual freeform output: a watercolor observatory on a coastal cliff at blue hour, with warm window light and sea mist.
caption: Actual Infographic output, not a logo or interface screenshot. Watercolor observatory at blue hour. Display JPEG derivative.
flow_title: From your direction to retained work.
flow_intro: Use infographic structure when it helps. Leave it behind when it does not. The same local library retains plans, references, alternatives, reviews and linked revisions.
steps: Start from a brief, content references or style references. Choose guided infographics or freeform images, with explicit style, layout and provider choices.
Plan panels and layout automatically or override them. Request up to three alternatives, select one, then build related panels using the first rendered panel as a style anchor.
Supply a new direction with the existing images as inputs. Keep the original, the exact parent link and the new version. Download the composite or individual PNG panels.
detail_title: Structure when useful. Freedom when needed.
details: One to six panels, density-aware layouts, curated or custom aesthetics, dioramas and visual consistency across panels.
No compulsory headings, labels, diagrams or panels. Direct a scene, an aesthetic or an image-guided revision in your own words.
Image-based review separates execution from quality. Optional bounded repair is explicit, not a promise of perfect text or factual correctness.
Retained originals, alternatives, selections, references and revision history. Inspect existing work without model credentials.
prompt: Use Infographic to explain our release workflow in three claymation panels. Then help me review and refine the result without losing the original.
prerequisites: Requires uv and Python 3.13+. Generation requires a configured reasoning provider plus GOOGLE_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY for the separate Gemini image service.
model_note: Reasoning uses Amplifier Agent 0.22.0 (binding and engine). Choose OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, ChatGPT OAuth or GitHub Copilot. Your reasoning choice does not replace the Gemini image service. ChatGPT needs Agent-compatible OAuth login; GitHub needs Copilot entitlement. Explicit models are not silently substituted.

commands.title: Create from the CLI
commands.code:
infographic generate "Explain a heat pump to a homeowner" --panels 3 --layout horizontal --store ./results
infographic list --store ./results
infographic refine RESULT_ID "Use larger labels" --store ./results

commands.title: Create without infographic structure
commands.code: infographic generate "A watercolor coastal observatory at blue hour. No text." --mode freeform --orientation landscape --store ./results

limits: Generated small text can glitch. There is no web fact checking, perfect text guarantee, image-service cost estimate or pixel-identical edit guarantee.
Live reasoning exercised OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and GitHub. ChatGPT's missing-login failure was checked, but successful ChatGPT generation was not verified. macOS/Windows parity is not verified.

No MCP App yet, no cancellation or automatic crash replay, and no upstream-style per-candidate automatic screening/regeneration. Interrupted work remains inspectable. Vision and contracts remain drafts.
